key_insight: Q-PhotoMarket shows that photonic hybrid quantum neural network performance for market prediction depends strongly on circuit design choices, and systematic design-space exploration can uncover robust high-performing architectures.
engineering_relevance: The framework provides a practical way to search and validate photonic HQNN designs for finance, helping engineers move beyond one-off quantum circuit evaluations toward reproducible architecture selection.
method: Varied input photon states, circuit architectures, entangling models, and measurement strategies.
Used Bayesian optimization plus threshold calibration and prediction-collapse diagnostics.
evidence_signal: The authors evaluated the framework across U.S., Indian, and cryptocurrency markets, and report competitive performance against classical machine learning baselines.
watch_item: Results depend on threshold settings and valid photonic computation spaces, so deployment will require careful calibration and checks for prediction collapse under class imbalance.
paper_title: Q-PhotoMarket: A Design Space Exploration Framework for Photonic Hybrid Quantum Neural Networks in Financial Market Prediction
